attribution: BOS adaptation of Copenhagen Alliance Versification Working Group data. The sniffing rules derive from Tyndale/STEPBible TVTMS (David Instone-Brewer), credited by Copenhagen; preserve both attributions.

verificationSource.name: Open English Translation Literal Version and Readers Version
verificationSource.note: Verse contents were compared during the 2026-10-12 audit. These optional maintainer text files are not a runtime or test dependency; the verification summaries are recorded per correction. Revision 2 also records profile-data verification separately from direct OET text checks.

scope: Reviewed whole-group corrections for eng and vul in BOS book codes. Revision 2 audits all 556 Copenhagen split/merge rows, adds profile-verified corrections, and retains edition/textual/notation conflicts for review. Original Copenhagen files and reference counts are unchanged. Revision 3 prevents an invented identity for English Nehemiah 7:68, whose horses/mules are absent from the reference text. Revision 3 also verifies the English 2 Corinthians 13 greetings/benediction against source text and the corrected TVTMS table.

corrections.reason: Preserve the final greetings and benediction across the 14/13-verse chapter divisions.

evidence.verification: The pinned Copenhagen 2Co.13:12-13 rule has incomplete/inconsistent last-verse tests. STEPBible TVTMS at commit 4efdf91bbd0a45076ab5efab5d491ab2013fcad1, rows 3459-3463, explicitly gives English 14 verses and Greek 13: English 12-13 are Greek 12, English 14 is Greek 13. unmappedVerses.reason: The horses and mules listed in this verse are absent from the Hebrew reference text. No same-number substitute is valid.

evidence.verification: Copenhagen and STEPBible TVTMS identify the horses/mules verse as absent from Hebrew. OET-LV NEH 7:68 contains camels/donkeys (English 7:69), while Luther/English 7:68 lists horses/mules. Remove the implicit identity edge; do not turn 7:68 into the following verse. Native and same-system retrieval remains valid.
